classification: Retrospective development sample, not prospective validation
rule: Largest observed repayment case in each of the four Base/USDC families SOL, cbLTC, cbDOGE, cbZEC, plus the next-largest distinct SOL transaction (a multi-position batch) and a later-day large cbLTC case. These are NOT the six largest transactions globally.
clarification: This explicit selection rule supersedes the shorthand 'six largest distinct' in the collection script. Identity and repayment-size selection use already observed liquidation outcomes; no ex-ante detection or capture claimed.
